procedures.name: a01_flow_provenance_roundtrip
procedures.why: v1, v2 and v8: operating_point.flow_source and flow_quote equal the proposal's flow source and quote after lock, write_locked and read_locked

procedures.name: a02_declaration_edit
procedures.why: a copy of the nozzle template with only its title edited: declaration_sha, the lock sha and the eval key move, vocab_sha does not, compile_checks refuses the old lock with GATE-LOCK

procedures.name: a07_immutable_different_bytes
procedures.why: write_locked over another approver's bytes, over a lone rewritten lock file and over a directory: REQ-IMMUTABLE, nothing written

procedures.name: a08_immutable_identical_bytes
procedures.why: write_locked with byte-identical content is accepted and leaves both files untouched

procedures.name: a10_vocab_fresh_processes
procedures.why: reqs.py vocab twice in fresh processes gives the same bytes; one more catalogue quantity moves vocab_sha and the old proposal is refused REQ-VOCAB
